job: Sign a surface with the product mark and name, an uploaded logo or a wordmark.
purpose: The brand is a mark and a name, set in a 40px row. A customer logo can replace the mark as an image of 24px, or a wide logo can replace both (up to 160px wide; it cannot shrink to the rail). A wordmark is an SVG in the current colour, for a caption or a line of text. A product sets its brand once, as JSON in a data-fd-brand script or with setBrand(), and every fd-brand on the page is filled from it: the name, a picture mark or the initial of the name, a logo with a dark variant, the link.
useWhen: The top of the sidebar or a centred screen needs the product identity.
A page says "Powered by" with a small wordmark.
A product white-labels itself: one record of name, mark and logo fills the sidebar, the top bar, the auth screens and the docs bar.

avoidWhen.when: A person or a team needs an avatar.
A small rounded icon stands for an object, not the brand.
A label on a card or row.

states.name: filled
states.how: data-fd-brand JSON on a script (the page) or on a container (what is inside it), or setBrand(brand)

states.name: kept as written
states.how: data-fd-brand-keep on the brand; setBrand and data-fd-brand leave it alone

variants.useWhen: A wordmark inside a caption or a line of small text.
The wordmark is the brand itself and takes the accent.

parts.role: The 36px mark, an inline SVG or a 24px image.
A wide logo that stands in for the mark and the name.
An SVG wordmark that takes the current colour.
